per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must respond to user navigation within five seconds to ensure a snappy user experience.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The maximum wait time for a user navigating from one screen to another within the Disputes application shall be no more than 5 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must integrate with central identity for employee authentication and support federated identity or token-based approaches for external partners.
The system must enforce authorization at the API layer, including role-based restrictions, field masking for sensitive data, and approval flows for elevated actions.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall ensure that only authorized users are allowed to logon to the application.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must follow corporate standards for layout, components, and accessibility to ensure consistency with other corporate applications.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall comply with the corporate standards for user interface creation for internally and externally used applications.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must be compatible with older browsers used by external partners to avoid breaking compatibility.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall comply with the corporate standards for user interface creation for internally and externally used applications.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must be effectively always-on to support round-the-clock cardmember support, with scheduled maintenance windows for disruptive work.
The system must be designed to scale horizontally and make services stateless where practical to support up to 350 concurrent users.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall support 350 concurrent users without any degradation of performance in the application.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must log every action on a dispute with enough context for auditors to reconstruct the event, ensuring logs are tamper-evident and routed to the central logging stack.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application must maintain a detailed history of every action that a user takes on a dispute case. This ensures a complete audit trail if questions arise later on with regard to a particular dispute case.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must obtain all transaction details from the Statement DB as the source of truth, with the ability to validate or refresh data as needed.
